title: Braised Brussels Sprouts with Ukrainian Twist
description: A hearty, comforting vegan dish that combines the natural sweetness of Brussels sprouts with the flavors of Ukrainian cuisine. Perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Cut the Brussels sprouts in half and remove any damaged leaves.
In a large bowl, toss the Brussels sprouts with the braising liquid, nutritional yeast, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Transfer the Brussels sprouts to a baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 20 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the sprouts are tender and caramelized.
Meanwhile, slice the warm Ukrainian bread into 1-inch pieces.
In a small saucepan, melt the vegan butter over low heat.
Add the sliced bread to the saucepan and toast for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until crispy and golden brown.
To assemble the dish, place a few pieces of toasted bread on a plate, then top with a portion of the braised Brussels sprouts.
